feat(OMN-20287): GLM Coding Plan allowance awareness and usage events as compute nodes (#3660)
- Added node_glm_allowance_compute: contract.yaml, a declarative node, and handler HandlerGlmAllowance.handle(ModelGlmAllowanceRequest) -> ModelGlmAllowanceResult.
- From recent usage records, provider cap refusals and an allowance policy it returns what is left of the rolling window and of the weekly period (cap, used, remaining, reserve, usable, remaining fraction, reset), a verdict (prefer_glm, allow_glm, skip_glm, no_glm_rung), the chain order to try and the GLM rungs skipped with a reason.

--- change 3 (repo omnibase_core, pull request #1869) ---
fix(OMN-17427): a binding for a merged fix must fail at the merge base with that fix reverted (#1869)
The gate now reads a Binds-Merged-Fix trailer from binding commits.
From git it checks the sha is merged at the merge base, has one parent and cites the ticket.
The control reverts the fix product changes at the merge base.
This ensures the bound tests fail only due to the missing fix.
Fixes changing no product path or failing to revert are refused.
A pull request naming a merged fix that touches a non-test, non-contract path is refused.
Tickets without the trailer keep the original merge base c
